about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a frontend-focused software engineer based in Zurich, working at an international tech consulting firm. My stack revolves around TypeScript and Next.js — but I'm comfortable across the full stack when needed.
about.p2: I care about building things that actually get used. Not just clean code for its own sake, but products that people interact with and find valuable. I bring both technical depth and the communication skills to work effectively with teams and stakeholders.
